[RBND.6.3] **No call site in a runtime reimplements the comparison.** A
runtime's load path MUST use the comparisons of [RBND.6.1] rather than testing
fields individually; that is what keeps the contract single-sourced, and a
hand-rolled comparator is how one field quietly stops being checked.
A path needing both bindings performs both in sequence and surfaces
the first mismatch.

A reader outside a runtime, which pairs a trace with a DSC without a runtime's
replayer, may make the dialect-binding comparison in its own code. [RFCS.4.5]
and [RBND.5] bind that comparison as they bind a runtime's, and the reader must
carry [RBND.8.1]'s conformance tests for it.
